sloka: प्रकृत्या राक्षसाः सर्वे सङ्ग्रामे कूटयोधिनः ।शूराणां शुद्धभावानां भवतामार्जवं बलम् ।। ६.५०.५३ ।।।।
transliteration: prakṛtyā rākṣasāḥ sarve saṅgrāme kūṭayodhinaḥ ।śūrāṇāṁ śuddhabhāvānāṁ bhavatāmārjavaṁ balam ।। 6.50.53 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rakshasas by nature use tricks in war. For noble people with good nature guilelessness is strength."
